exposure: Elevated serum alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels in early pregnancy
cohort: Participants were 12,057 patients from Jinxin Women's and Children's Hospital who delivered single live births between 2020 and 2023.
finding: Elevated ALT levels in early pregnancy and gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) both affected neonatal birth weight, with GDM partly mediating the effect of elevated ALT on neonatal birth weight, accounting for 8.1% of the mediation effect.
